🇹🇭 | Supermarkets in Thailand, such as Rimping Supermarket in Chiang Mai, have successfully adopted biodegradable banana leaves to wrap fresh produce instead of single-use plastic. 

Secured with flexible bamboo twist ties, this traditional method provides a natural, sturdy, and waterproof layer for vegetables like peppers, cucumbers, and spring onions.

Because banana leaves are a readily available agricultural byproduct in tropical climates, the initiative offers an elegant, low-tech way to combat plastic pollution.

Courage the Cowardly Dog!🐶📺

Premiered on Cartoon Network in 1999, Courage the Cowardly Dog is a beloved American animated horror-comedy series created by John R. Dilworth. 

The series follows Courage, a timid pink dog who lives with his elderly owners, Muriel and Eustace, on an isolated farm in the middle of Nowhere. Despite his constant fear, Courage repeatedly finds himself facing supernatural creatures, bizarre villains, and terrifying situations to protect his family. 

It became a cult classic thanks to its eerie atmosphere, surreal humor, memorable characters, and unique blend of horror, comedy, and emotional storytelling.
